panel.title: Let's find the right start for your project
panel.sub: A few quick questions, then we'll tell you: start with bazaars, or look for a fixed space?
panel.recoBar: This is the step we suggest based on your answers.

have.t: What do you have right now?

opts.product: A product or service that's ready
opts.skill: A skill or experience I want to turn into a business

opts.shop: I have a shop or a fixed spot
opts.homeEvents: From home or at pop-up events
opts.onlineFew: Online, but orders are still few

soldBefore.t: Have you sold any of it before?

opts.customers: Yes, and I have repeat customers

fieldExp.t: Do you have experience in this field?

opts.none: No, this is my first try

skillSrc.t: Where does your experience come from?

opts.years: I worked in it for years

pastWork.t: Have you worked in a particular field before?

goal.t: What do you want to achieve now?

opts.newAudience: Test a new area or audience

readyNow.t: Is it ready to sell right now?

opts.almost: Almost — needs a bit of work

canBuild.t: Can you build the idea yourself?

soldSkill.t: Have you sold this skill before?

haveNow.t: What do you have to start with?

budget.t: Last one — if you found the right place, where do you stand financially?

opts.ready: I have the budget and I'm ready to commit monthly
opts.validate: I have the budget, but I'd rather test first
opts.limited: My budget is tight — I'd start with the lowest cost

expandFixed.title: A fixed space suits you
expandFixed.why: You're already selling ({{sell}}), and your goal now is to {{goal}} — the next step is a place where people see you every day.

budget.title: Put your money into stock, not rent
budget.why: You're already selling ({{sell}}), but your available capital is limited relative to a monthly commitment. A bazaar lets you sell and grow without loading a fixed monthly cost onto the business.

weak.title: Steady the demand first
weak.why: You're already selling ({{sell}}), but demand is still occasional. A bazaar puts you in front of new customers so you can see how the product performs before committing to monthly rent.

audience.title: Test the new audience first
audience.why: You're already selling ({{sell}}) and your goal now is to {{goal}} — a bazaar reaches new audiences and areas without tying you to one location.

validate.title: Your instinct is right — confirm first
validate.why: You can afford the commitment, but you chose to confirm the product sells first. Try a bazaar, see your real numbers, and then a fixed space becomes a calculated decision rather than a gamble.

plain.title: Test before you commit
plain.why: Your {{act}} is ready but hasn't sold yet — the cheapest way to learn whether people will buy is a few days at a bazaar, before you pay a month's rent.

budget.title: Test at the lowest possible cost
budget.why: Your {{act}} is ready but hasn't sold yet, and your budget is tight. A bazaar lets you test it for a small one-off cost instead of a monthly commitment on an unproven product.

skillToOffer.title: Turn your skill into something sellable
skillToOffer.why: You have real experience in {{act}} ({{exp}}) but it isn't packaged as an offer yet — define the service and its price first, then test it in front of an audience.

a.title: It's early for rent — and that's fine
a.why: There's nothing to sell yet, and any rent would be a cost on a business that hasn't started. Get your first sellable product ready, then come back to us.

b.title: You've started — but it's early for rent
b.why: You have sold ({{sell}}), but sales are still occasional. Steady the demand first, and then rent becomes an investment rather than a burden.

c.title: Your experience is your biggest asset
c.why: You've actually worked in {{act}} — not many people have that. Start from it: decide what you could offer yourself tomorrow, and test it with your first customers before any commitment.

note.infra: Your line of work ({{act}}) needs power, water and permits — ask about those anywhere before you book.
note.noBazaars: The advice stands — but there's no bazaar open for booking on Makani Spot right now.
